summary: End-to-end verification of iteration_18 features: Voice Take Vault (UI + persistence + badge), Cloud Handoff (SEND + RECEIVE by code + RECEIVE via ?code= link + bad code error), Load & Replace whole show (Replace-All vs Merge with per-playlist prompts), and Backup Reminder (appear/save/reappear/dismiss). Backend /api/shows CRUD verified via pytest (5/5 pass). Frontend E2E verified via Playwright with dialog + download handlers.

integration_issues.issue: The auto-doReceive() useEffect appears to run twice on mount (likely React StrictMode double-invocation): the whole-show Replace-All confirm dialog is shown twice back-to-back on a single link open, causing a duplicate GET /api/shows/{code} call and a duplicate applyImport pass. cloud-received still resolves correctly but this is user-visible noise.

issues: Persistent React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (pre-existing, carried over from iteration_17). Not blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Gate the CloudHandoffModal auto-doReceive() effect with a ref/guard so it only fires once even under React StrictMode (e.g., a useRef 'didAutoFetch' flag), so users don't see the Replace-All confirm twice when opening a share link.
Optional (from prev iteration): clean the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CloudHandoffModal.js L47-50: useEffect(() => { if (initialCode) doReceive(); }, []) is not idempotent — under React 18 StrictMode dev double-invoke (and any parent re-mount), doReceive fires twice, producing a duplicate window.confirm and duplicate applyImport. Add a `useRef(false)` guard.

App.js applyImport uses window.confirm for Replace-All vs Merge — synchronous blocking dialogs are hard to test and inaccessible; consider a proper modal for the whole-show top-level choice (per-playlist same-name prompts can remain).
App.js is now ~2354 lines. Vault + Cloud + Import/Export + Backup logic could be extracted to /lib/showIO.js and a useVault hook for maintainability.
TakesVault delete uses window.confirm inline; consistent modal confirm would be nicer.

backend/server.py /api/shows uses a 6-char code with 32-char alphabet (~1B combinations) and 6 retries on collision — fine for MVP; consider adding an index on shared_shows.code for O(1) lookups as volume grows.
seed_data_creation: Backend: POST /api/shows was called by the frontend Cloud upload button; test also creates & GETs a TEST_Show payload via pytest. Frontend: injected one vault take (id='testvid1') into localStorage 'hotlive95_state' to verify persistence + badge + list rendering (audio blob not present so play/insert not exercised for that seeded take). Also generated /tmp/test_show.hl95playout with 2 playlists to exercise Replace-All vs Merge.

voice_take_vault.note: Actual recording via voice-record-toggle was NOT executed end-to-end because the count-in + MediaRecorder + autoTranscription pipeline is hard to drive headlessly; vault ROW was seeded via localStorage to exercise the drawer UI and persistence. Insert/Download/Delete buttons render with correct testids; deletion path uses window.confirm.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Activation: key Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T; after Activate click, check legal-agree-checkbox then click legal-accept-button. Handle window.confirm via page.on('dialog') — accept=Replace/Replace-All, dismiss=Merge/Add-as-copy. beforeunload fires on navigation with dirty state — auto-accept. Cloud share codes are 6 uppercase chars (alphabet excludes 0/1/I/O). Vault takes persist inside localStorage 'hotlive95_state' under `.vault`; audio blobs live in IndexedDB via /app/frontend/src/lib/db.js.
rca of the issue: Cloud auto-receive double-fire RCA: CloudHandoffModal.js `useEffect(() => { if (initialCode) doReceive(); }, [])` is not guarded and runs twice under React 18 StrictMode dev mount, causing (1) 2x GET /api/shows/{code}, (2) 2x applyImport → 2x window.confirm on non-empty studios. Fix: add a `const didFetch = useRef(false)` guard and early-return if `didFetch.current` is true before invoking doReceive.
